product_overview: A comprehensive web-based application designed for managing medical equipment lifecycle within healthcare facilities, including equipment inventory, usage tracking, maintenance scheduling, repair requests, transfers, user management, and reporting, with role-based access control and mobile optimization.
core_goals: Provide an intuitive interface for managing medical equipment inventory with support for search, filtering, and QR code scanning.
Enable real-time tracking of equipment usage and status updates to maintain accurate operational data.
Support comprehensive maintenance planning and repair request workflows with role and department-based authorization.
Facilitate seamless equipment transfer between departments and external entities with full audit trails.
Deliver insightful reporting and dashboards for performance monitoring and decision-making.
Ensure secure user authentication and role-based access control to protect sensitive information.
Optimize user experience with mobile responsiveness and support for Progressive Web App installation.
key_features: Custom authentication system with support for plain and hashed passwords and multi-role, department-based access control.
Full CRUD operations for medical equipment with detailed technical data, status monitoring, and bulk import/export via Excel.
Real-time usage session tracking, mobile-optimized interaction, and active usage indicators.
Repair request creation, approval workflows, and status tracking tailored to department roles.
Maintenance plan creation, task scheduling, batch scheduling capabilities, and progress tracking with completion marking.
Equipment transfer management supporting internal and external transfers with status monitoring and approval.
Administrative user management including role/department assignment and user status maintenance.
Interactive dashboards and reporting with charts and export options for equipment status, maintenance, and usage statistics.
QR code scanning functionality allowing quick access to device information and related actions such as repair requests.
Progressive Web App support enabling offline usage, push notifications, and installation on mobile devices.
Deployment pipeline supporting dual hosting on Vercel and Cloudflare Workers for high availability.
Database schema and migration scripts optimized for performance and department-based filtering.
user_flow_summary: Users authenticate via a secure login system with role-appropriate access to modules.
After login, users access a dashboard presenting key metrics, notifications, and navigation.
Equipment managers can add, edit, import from Excel, and manage the medical equipment catalog with search and filtering by department and status.
Users can scan equipment QR codes to view details, log usage sessions, or create repair requests directly.
Maintenance planners create and manage maintenance plans, add tasks, and mark completion either individually or via bulk scheduling.
Authorized personnel create, track, and approve repair requests with status-based filtering.
Transfers are initiated for internal or external equipment movement, with role-based approval workflows and tracking.
Administrators manage user accounts, including creating new users, assigning roles and departments, editing or disabling accounts.
Users view and interact with dynamic reports and charts, with the ability to export data for offline analysis.
Mobile users benefit from PWA installation for offline access and better engagement.
validation_criteria: Users can successfully authenticate with correct credentials and are restricted based on roles and department assignments.
Equipment CRUD operations reflect immediately in the system with consistent data validation and error handling.
QR code scanning reliably identifies the correct equipment and surfaces the appropriate UI with actionable options.
Repair requests follow the defined workflow from creation, approval, to completion, and status updates are accurately tracked.
Maintenance plans and tasks can be created, updated, bulk scheduled, and completed with data persisting correctly.
Transfers between departments and external entities track request status accurately with appropriate access controls enforced.
User management features allow admins to add, edit, delete, and assign roles/departments with immediate effect.
Dashboard and reports display accurate, up-to-date information with correct visualizations and export functions working as expected.
PWA installation is possible on supported devices, and offline mode works with cached data.
Real-time synchronization ensures that equipment and usage data updates propagate promptly across connected clients.
Import and export of equipment data through Excel files are processed without data corruption and with user feedback.
System meets performance benchmarks for loading times and responsiveness under typical usage scenarios.

features.name: Authentication System

features.name: Equipment Management
features.description: Comprehensive medical equipment management with CRUD operations, status tracking, QR code scanning, department-based filtering, search functionality

features.name: Equipment Usage Tracking
features.description: Real-time usage logging, start/end usage sessions, mobile-optimized usage actions, active usage indicators

features.name: Repair Request Management

features.name: Maintenance Management
features.description: Maintenance planning and scheduling, maintenance plan creation and editing, maintenance task management

features.name: Transfer Management
features.description: Equipment transfer between departments, transfer request creation, transfer history tracking

features.name: User Management
features.description: Administrative user management system with role assignment, department assignment, user status tracking

features.name: Dashboard & Reporting
